title.zh: v2.1.18 手机端（M4）：即兴——律动编排、打击垫，速度条移到底部
title.en: v2.1.18 Phone (M4): 即兴 — a Groove Grid, Pads, and the Tempo Bar at the Bottom

highlights.zh: **即兴模块按你的取舍建成**：4 轨 × 16 步的律动网格（点格子开关、播放时列高亮跟着音频时钟走、一键还原母版）＋ 6 个打击垫 ＋ 顶部**录制/播放**按钮；**BPM 与摇摆条移到了屏幕最下方**；**去掉了底/军/镲那排鼓组静音**；这个模块**不显示播放条**（它自己的走带就是循环本身）。
highlights.en: **The jam module is built to your spec**: a 4-lane x 16-step groove grid (tap a step to toggle it, the playhead column follows the audio clock, one tap resets to the genre's own pattern), six pads, and record/play at the top; the **BPM and swing bar moved to the bottom of the screen**; the **drum-group mute row is gone**; and the module shows **no player bar** (its transport is the loop itself).

highlights.zh: **两处刻意的取舍，都写在代码注释里**：① 打击垫是**步进输入**而不是现场鼓组——这个引擎没有对外的单次触发路径（为打击延迟再造一个 AudioContext 比不提供更糟），所以开「录制」后点打击垫就把**当前播放步**写进网格（落在播放头上，本身就是量化的），播放时垫子会跟着点亮；② 写入的是**点击瞬间正在播放的那一步**（读时钟，而不是用 80 ms 采样的 playhead）——180 BPM 时那 80 ms 就是整整一步，否则按感觉点会晚一格。
highlights.en: **Two deliberate trade-offs, both recorded in the code**: (1) the pads are **step entry**, not a live drum kit - this engine has no public one-shot trigger, and adding a second AudioContext for pad latency would be worse than not offering it, so arming record writes the **current step** (quantised by definition, because it lands on the playhead) and the pads light up as their lane fires; (2) the write lands on the step playing **at click time** rather than on the 80 ms-sampl…

highlights.zh: **编辑立刻可听见**：网格改动通过一个按内容比较的效应推给引擎（`setPattern`，不重启播放），速度/摇摆同理——所以「改一步、下一小节听到」是即时反馈，而不是停下再播。
highlights.en: **Edits are audible immediately**: grid changes are pushed to the engine through a content-compared effect (`setPattern`, without restarting playback), and so are tempo and swing - so 'change a step, hear it next bar' is real feedback rather than stop-and-play.
